name: Content Approval Workflow
bpmn:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn2:definitions xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:bpmn2="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:sling="http://sling.apache.org/bpmn" id="Definitions_contentApproval" targetNamespace="http://sling.apache.org/workflow">
  <bpmn2:process id="contentApproval" name="Content Approval Workflow" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn2:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Content Ready">
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:startEvent>
    <bpmn2:userTask id="Task_ReviewContent" name="Review Content">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <sling:candidateGroup>editors</sling:candidateGroup>
        <sling:formKey>content-review-form</sling:formKey>
        <sling:priority>60</sling:priority>
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:userTask>
    <bpmn2:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Approved?">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn2:outgoing>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_PublishContent" name="Publish Content">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <sling:delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.PublishDelegate</sling:delegateClass>
        <sling:field name="replicationAction" value="activate" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyApproved" name="Notify - Approved">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <sling:delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.SendEmailDelegate</sling:delegateClass>
        <sling:field name="template" value="/etc/workflow/email-templates/approval" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyRejected" name="Notify - Rejected">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <sling:delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.SendEmailDelegate</sling:delegateClass>
        <sling:field name="template" value="/etc/workflow/email-templates/rejection" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:endEvent id="EndEvent_Published" name="Content Published">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn2:incoming>
    </bpmn2:endEvent>
    <bpmn2:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Content Rejected">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn2:incoming>
    </bpmn2:endEvent>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_ReviewContent" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewContent" targetRef="Gateway_Approval" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_PublishContent">
      <bpmn2:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn2:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_NotifyRejected">
      <bpmn2:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression">${approved == false}</bpmn2:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_PublishContent" targetRef="Task_NotifyApproved" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyApproved" targetRef="EndEvent_Published" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRejected" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />
  </bpmn2:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_1">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_1" bpmnElement="contentApproval">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_1_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_1">
        <dc:Bounds x="152" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_ReviewContent_di" bpmnElement="Task_ReviewContent">
        <dc:Bounds x="240" y="80" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Gateway_Approval_di" bpmnElement="Gateway_Approval" isMarkerVisible="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="395" y="95" width="50" height="50" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_PublishContent_di" bpmnElement="Task_PublishContent">
        <dc:Bounds x="500" y="80" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_NotifyApproved_di" bpmnElement="Task_NotifyApproved">
        <dc:Bounds x="660" y="80" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_NotifyRejected_di" bpmnElement="Task_NotifyRejected">
        <dc:Bounds x="500" y="200" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_Published_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_Published">
        <dc:Bounds x="822" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_Rejected_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_Rejected">
        <dc:Bounds x="662" y="222" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_1_di" bpmnElement="Flow_1">
        <di:waypoint x="188" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="240" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_2_di" bpmnElement="Flow_2">
        <di:waypoint x="340" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="395" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_Approved_di" bpmnElement="Flow_Approved">
        <di:waypoint x="445" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="500" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_Rejected_di" bpmnElement="Flow_Rejected">
        <di:waypoint x="420" y="145" />
        <di:waypoint x="420" y="240" />
        <di:waypoint x="500" y="240" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_3_di" bpmnElement="Flow_3">
        <di:waypoint x="600" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="660" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_4_di" bpmnElement="Flow_4">
        <di:waypoint x="760" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="822" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_5_di" bpmnElement="Flow_5">
        <di:waypoint x="600" y="240" />
        <di:waypoint x="662" y="240" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn2:definitions>
